zip_data_pipelines: zip multiple DataPipeline instances together to combine their outputs element-wise into lists
zip_pipelines_with_names: zip DataPipelines with names parameter to produce dicts with named keys instead of lists
zip_pipelines_with_flatten: zip DataPipelines with flatten=True to merge list or dict outputs into a single flat structure
zip_to_shortest_pipeline: zip DataPipelines with zip_to_shortest=True to stop iteration at the shortest pipeline length
save_restore_zip_state: save and restore the state of a zipped DataPipeline using state_dict and load_state_dict
